name: hf_no_eval
title: HuggingFace fine-tune that never evaluates anything
origin: written alongside ANA-7 to exercise MLV708 (Sprint 4)
tunedWhy: the rules were developed against this project, so its numbers are a ceiling, not a measurement - it is excluded from the unseen headline in ACCURACY.md
note: No `graph` block: added for its findings, not for a hand-drawn diagram.

expected.defect: the Trainer has no eval_dataset, no compute_metrics, and TrainingArguments names no evaluation strategy
expected.why: the only number the run reports is the training loss, so overfitting is invisible and the checkpoint kept is the last one rather than the best one

forbidden.why: transformers.set_seed(SEED) is called at line 22 and TrainingArguments carries seed=SEED
the HuggingFace Trainer owns the optimisation loop - no hand-written backward/step exists here
same: there is no gradient update in this file for a rule to find missing
no metric is computed anywhere in this project - that absence is what MLV708 reports, and MLV305 has nothing to judge

graph.drawnBy: drawn from the source on 2026-09-14 (GRAPH-R3), following the convention the sibling `hf_trainer_finetune` program already established; scored 6 of 6 against the pre-change analyzer, so the block is not a record of what this tree happens to draw
